release: OculoStudio v0.21.53 — Evidence-Guided Body Review Reduction
feature_guarantees: Automatic Body relation/entity/region targets are never changed by review reduction.
Homogeneous candidate-only fixations may be auto-accepted only after target, angular, confidence, temporal-continuity and competing-surface checks.
Target conflicts, self occlusion, close competing surfaces, missing preview evidence and low-confidence geometry remain pending.
Existing v0.21.52+ sample-clock Body AOI can be reprocessed without rerunning C3D interpolation or ray intersection.
The source artifact remains immutable and saved manual decisions block reprocessing to avoid silent loss of human work.
Review events are displayed separately from high-rate gaze sample counts.
notes: The real reduction for S001/I01 cannot be predicted from the screenshot alone; run Re-evaluate saved evidence to obtain before/after event counts.
The live UI test used a deterministic synthetic project. Core sample-clock and geometry regressions were run from the final installed wheel.
Windows batch paths and wheel references were statically checked; the actual Windows installation executes on the user machine.
